axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.title: Privacy Analyst - Houston
axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as a Privacy Analyst at Axiom We are currently seeking a Privacy Analyst in Houston to work with some of the world’s largest companies across multiple industries. This is an existing vacancy. Location: Houston Responsibilities: Conduct privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and related risk assessments to evaluate the collection, use, storage, and sharing of personal data. Identify and analyze privacy risks associated with new and existing products, technologies, and business processes, and recommend mitigation strategies. Support website and digital privacy compliance, including reviews of cookies, tracking technologies, disclosures, consent mechanisms, and data flows. Assist in maintaining and updating privacy documentation, policies, notices, and internal guidance materials. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support privacy-by-design principles and ensure privacy requirements are integrated into projects early. Monitor privacy-related issues, escalations, and remediation efforts, tracking actions to completion. Must be able to go on-site in Houston. Qualifications: 4+ years of experience working in the data privacy space. Demonstrated experience in privacy and data protection, including impact and risk assessments. Strong understanding of website privacy concepts, such as cookies, tracking technologies, and consent management. Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, well-structured assessments, reports, and policies. Strong verbal communication skills, capable of explaining privacy risks and requirements to technical and non-technical audiences. Analytical mindset with attention to detail and sound judgment in risk evaluation. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-325,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. About Axiom: For over 25 years, Axiom has pioneered the alternative legal services industry, now serving more than 1,500 legal departments globally with our unique blend of world-class legal talent and advanced AI tools, delivering innovative solutions ranging from that combine top-tier talent with cutting-edge technology. We tackle complex legal matters across 12 practice areas for clients ranging from Fortune 100 to SMBs, empowering our legal professionals to engage in meaningful work that advances their careers. Our Talent NPS score of +71% and our Client NPS score of +64% highlight our commitment to excellence ( Reported scores were Axiom’s average for 2025 – the legal industry average NPS score is +35% ). Join our forward-thinking community where you’ll keep your career dynamic and multi-faceted, be part of a company that values agility, collaboration, and excellence, and love both the law and your life. Learn more about life at Axiom . Axiom is the global leader in high-caliber, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in class alterative legal services. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:a0.title: Assistant Innkeeper
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:a0.description: Start your mornings at the historic Timberholm Inn! Since 1949, our bed & breakfast has welcomed travelers, adventurers, and families alike, offering a slice of history with the ambiance of a bygone era. Recognized by the Stowe Historical Society as one of the original ski lodges of the area, Timberholm continues to be a cherished destination year-round. We are seeking a detail-oriented and guest-focused Assistant Innkeeper to create memorable morning experiences for guests at our 9-room boutique bed and breakfast. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the art of breakfast, thrives in a collaborative team environment, and takes pride in creating seamless, personalized experiences for guests from first contact to their next stay. Training will be provided, along with ongoing support during the transition and beyond. If you have a passion for cooking or baking, a keen eye for cleanliness, and a welcoming personality, we would love to have you join our team. Days: 2 mornings per week, Thursday & Sunday Shift Length: 4 hours Standard Hours: 7:00 AM – 11:00 AM, breakfast served at 8:00 am Ski Season Hours: 6:00 AM - 10:00 AM, breakfast served at 7:00 am
responsibilities: Arrive early to prep ingredients and bake/cook high-quality breakfast items for guests.
Lay out and maintain the buffet breakfast selection throughout the service window.
Label and communicate allergy/special dietary needs foods clearly.
Brew coffee and have hot water available for tea/hot chocolate.
Examples of prepared breakfast items include: scrambled eggs, pancakes, waffles, bacon.
Restock coffee and tea stations throughout the morning.
Keep fridge items, snacks, and beverage stations fully replenished for the day ahead.
Communicate any low-inventory items or kitchen needs to leadership.
Greet guests warmly and exhibit a high standard of hospitality and professionalism.
Interact with guests during breakfast, answering basic questions about Timberholm and the surrounding areas and making them feel welcome.
Address guest inquiries or dietary needs during service with care and professionalism.
Coordinate closely with Hannah on any special requests or guest/inn concerns.
Resolve minor guest issues and escalate to the leadership team when necessary.
Efficiently handle all breakfast cleanup, including washing dishes, sanitizing cookware, and clearing tables.
Mop the kitchen floor and thoroughly vacuum the Great Room after service concludes.
Ensure all remaining food is properly stored, labeled, and put away according to food safety standards.
Coordinate regularly with Hannah/broader team on critical guest and inn related items.
Support a positive, communicative, and team-oriented work environment
qualifications: Authorized to work in the United States
Ability to communicate in English, both written and verbal
Valid state issued driver’s license and current auto insurance
Basic computer skills
Comply with all company policies and procedures
Exemplify a high-performance culture through words and actions
Present a positive image as the face of Timberholm Inn in the market, industry, and our community.
Hospitality-minded with a focus on delivering excellent guest experiences
Strong communicator with a warm, friendly demeanor
Dependable for early mornings and twice weekly shifts
Problem-solver who can handle guest concerns with professionalism
Detail oriented and uses time efficiently
Physical stamina to stand for long periods, bend, lift, and handle tasks such as mopping and vacuuming

jobgether-jobgether:lever:371dcfb3-dceb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer - PostgreSQL based in Austria. This is an opportunity to join a distributed open-source software team focused on PostgreSQL and related database technologies. You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Working closely with engineers, product managers, QA, and fellow technical writers, you’ll turn complex technical concepts into practical resources for diverse audiences. The role combines technical writing, documentation strategy, developer tooling, and hands-on exploration of database systems. You’ll work in a docs-as-code environment and use modern AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work. With a high degree of autonomy, flexible working hours, and a global team, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys both deep technical work and collaborative open-source environments. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including installation and configuration guides, troubleshooting resources, how-to articles, user manuals, man pages, help prompts, and release documentation. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, developers, QA specialists, and other technical writers to produce accurate, timely, and high-quality documentation. Translate complex PostgreSQL and database concepts into clear, accessible content for users with different levels of technical expertise. Use Markdown, text, images, diagrams, and other formats to create engaging and effective documentation. Work within a docs-as-code methodology, maintaining documentation through version-controlled workflows and contributing to scalable documentation practices. Leverage AI-powered tools to draft, refine, structure, format, and improve technical content while maintaining accuracy and quality. Participate actively in team ceremonies, technical discussions, planning sessions, and other collaborative activities. Contribute to the broader documentation strategy and continuously improve writing standards, workflows, and processes. Engage with open-source communities through forums, mailing lists, and other communication channels, sharing knowledge and gathering technical insights. Research new technologies and contribute to upstream documentation, technical blog content, or other knowledge-sharing initiatives when appropriate. Help develop and maintain automated documentation testing, validation processes, and CI/CD workflows where applicable. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer, with a proven ability to produce precise, high-quality technical documentation. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical subjects clearly and effectively. Experience documenting complex software systems and producing user-oriented documentation for technical audiences. Strong familiarity with markup languages, particularly Markdown. Hands-on experience installing and configuring database server software on Linux. Practical experience with docs-as-code methodologies and tools such as Git, Jenkins, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript. Experience using AI tools to support technical documentation workflows. Comfortable working with the Linux command line and developer tools such as Git, GCC, and GDB. Understanding of distributed systems and/or database server development. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively within a globally distributed organization. Strong collaboration skills and experience communicating through tools such as Slack, Jira, Notion, Zoom, mailing lists, and community forums. Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and contribute positively as part of a distributed team. A developer or DevOps background is highly valued. jobgether-jobgether:lever:497842de-7620-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c0703a87-3a6d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a MarTech Engineer - AI & Automation based in United Kingdom. This is a high-impact role focused on building the automation backbone of a modern, AI-powered marketing organization. You’ll combine MarTech engineering, workflow automation, data, and AI agent integration to improve the entire customer journey. Starting within marketing and growth, your work will progressively influence automation initiatives across the wider organization. You’ll design intelligent workflows, connect business systems, and integrate AI capabilities into real-world processes. The role offers broad exposure across Growth, Marketing, Product, and Engineering in a fast-moving, remote-first environment. You’ll have significant ownership over technical solutions that improve scalability, experimentation, efficiency, and measurable growth. It’s an opportunity to help shape how AI-driven automation is adopted across a rapidly evolving technology business. Architect and implement AI-enhanced marketing automation workflows using platforms such as Customer.io, HubSpot, Make, Zapier, or similar tools. Integrate AI models and agents into lifecycle marketing activities, including lead capture, onboarding, messaging, campaign execution, reporting, and churn prediction. Build and maintain intelligent workflows spanning paid, organic, and lifecycle marketing channels. Prototype and deploy lightweight AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or comparable technologies. Design data flows, context management, and integrations that enable AI agents to work effectively with CRM, analytics, support, and campaign data. Connect AI agents and automation workflows to internal systems through APIs, webhooks, Make, Zapier, custom scripts, or native integrations. Manage marketing event tracking, attribution, funnel measurement, customer journey analytics, and SEO/content performance monitoring. Develop dashboards and reporting that enable rapid experimentation and data-driven decision-making. Customize and integrate CRM, CMS, landing-page, analytics, and campaign platforms, including Webflow, Unbounce, and Looker Studio. Build internal tools and automation scripts using Python or Node.js to reduce manual work and improve go-to-market efficiency. Maintain and evolve APIs, webhooks, integrations, and marketing data pipelines. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Growth to establish appropriate triggers, access, feedback loops, and infrastructure for AI agents and automation. Champion an automation-first approach and contribute to the roadmap for expanding AI agent capabilities into areas such as support, operations, and onboarding. Requirements: 2–3 years of experience in MarTech, marketing automation, technical growth, or a closely related engineering role. Strong experience with CRM customization, marketing automation, and workflow design. Practical knowledge of APIs, webhooks, event tracking, analytics, and data pipelines. Experience with tools such as Customer.io, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Make, Zapier, Pipedream, Segment, RudderStack, PostHog, Amplitude, or Mixpanel. Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Webflow, Unbounce, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Strong interest in or hands-on experience with AI tools, agent architectures, prompt engineering, or LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini. Knowledge of AI agent frameworks, vector databases, memory systems, context injection, or lightweight agent orchestration is a plus. Ability to write automation and integration logic in Python or Node.js. Understanding of REST APIs, data integration patterns, Git, and technical workflow development. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:1b7a7aa8-ce9.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com As a Tech Linguistic Tester 1, you will primarily be proofreading and editing content already localized to your native language, making sure that you catch any errors in the content, such as: grammar, typos, syntax, punctuation, capitalization, political incorrectness, inconsistencies, and extra spaces between words or characters. You will sometimes be translating content from English to your native language. You will also be checking UIs for functional issues.
